name: Task Verification
description: Verify task outputs against acceptance criteria to render structured pass or fail verdicts.
_deploy_gate_note: v5: added the Deploy/Publish Gate — a deploy/publish criterion passes only on an observed HTTP-200 fetch of the exact claimed URL (right site/channel), never on a CLI 'deployed ✅' line (B-28). Closes the live false-complete where a deploy served 404 yet reported success.
_scripts_note: report_pass/report_fail are GATEWAY-NATIVE tool calls registered in corekit/brain/tools.mjs, not shell binaries — the cerebellum invokes them as functions and verdict.mjs reads the chosen name as the verdict. No manifest installs them to bin/, which is correct. '_scripts_kind': 'gateway' tells the phantom-capability check (validate-contracts 14c) not to expect a bin/ entry.
when_to_use: When dispatched to verify a task output against acceptance criteria.
